about_the_game:
💥Match three to ignite romance💥

Each match three level is closely linked to the unique wishes of the beautiful girls. Players complete tasks to unlock their sweet illustrations by matching purple magic rune blocks. The level content is rich and varied, from simple finger sliding to brain-intensive strategy puzzles, which are suitable for both leisure and relaxation and can challenge your skills.

Character Introductions

🟣Huang Li: A once rebellious girl, now a wealthy wife, yet trapped in the shackles of marriage, she longs for her former freedom.

🟣Luo Er: Emily's personal maid, she appears loyal and dutiful, yet harbors complex feelings for her master.

🟣Mei Lin: The perfect wife praised by everyone, but beneath her perfect figure lies a hidden loneliness and longing.

💋You can experience💋

  • Diverse goals: Each level of the level task is related to the strange needs of the beautiful girls, such as preparing magic rituals for them or unlocking heart-moving moments.

  • Strategic challenge: Advanced levels introduce step limits or random magic effects to test your planning and adaptability.

  • Plot linkage: The magic crystals obtained by match three can unlock illustrations, promote intimacy with beautiful girls, and upgrade the sweetness step by step~

  • One-click skip: No pressure when stuck, one-click skip directly enters the plot and illustrations, and easily enjoys a romantic experience.

  • 12 exquisite illustrations: From daily sweet interactions to romantic scenes, each illustration is delicate and beautiful, showing the multi-faceted charm of beautiful girls.

Click to add to wishlist! Start your purple fantasy journey——💜
